description: Ralph-ready RDPEGFX shadow alignment plan for OmniRDP. The work hardens the viewer-side RDPEGFX path so it behaves like a reliable shadow framebuffer publisher: per-viewer dirty accumulation, safe coalescing, producer/client race safety, conservative pacing and fallback behavior, coordinate validation, lifecycle cleanup, diagnostics, and validation evidence. Backend codec negotiation must remain unchanged; do not enable backend NSCodec, RemoteFX, or backend GFX.

userStories.title: Harden per-viewer pending dirty accumulator
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want each RDPEGFX viewer to keep its own pending dirty region accumulator so skipped or deferred backend updates cannot lose invalid regions and leave stale or black fragments.
acceptanceCriteria: RDPEGFX viewers accumulate dirty rectangles per viewer rather than relying only on the global latest framebuffer dirty list.
Classic viewers and viewer.gfx.enabled=false behavior remain unchanged.
Accumulator state tracks start generation, latest generation, rect count, full-frame/overflow state, and enough counters to diagnose pending work.
Accumulation ignores stale generations already sent to that viewer.
Unit tests cover multiple generations accumulated before send and latest-generation preservation.

userStories.title: Add dirty region union/coalescing thresholds
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dirty regions to be merged and bounded so RDPEGFX sends complete coverage without unbounded rect growth or excessive fragmentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Dirty rectangles are validated, clamped, and merged when they overlap or are adjacent according to RECTANGLE_16 inclusive coordinates.
A configurable or documented maximum pending-rect threshold forces a full-frame dirty batch when exceeded.
A documented area threshold, initially around 60 percent of the surface, forces full-frame dirty coverage when incremental regions become too large.
Full-frame fallback uses one rect covering left=0, top=0, right=width-1, bottom=height-1.
Unit tests cover overlap/adjacency merge, max-rect overflow, area-threshold fallback, empty dirty input, and dirty-overflow input.

userStories.title: Fix producer/consumer move-remerge race safety
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want moving pending dirty work to a send batch and re-merging deferred work to be race-safe so new producer updates are not overwritten by an older deferred batch.
acceptanceCriteria: The viewer loop moves pending dirty state under the viewer GFX lock only after pacing allows a send.
New dirty updates that arrive while a batch is being encoded/sent remain pending and are preserved.
Deferred sends re-merge the moved batch with any newer pending dirty regions instead of replacing them.
Denied-but-nonfatal dirty sends re-merge moved pending work and wake the viewer loop when appropriate.
Unit tests cover move preserving new updates added after move, deferred remerge, and empty pending move behavior.

Debug build passes
CTest passes

userStories.title: Audit and enforce coordinate convention
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want all framebuffer, dirty-region, and RDPEGFX surface command paths to use one documented coordinate convention so off-by-one and clipping errors cannot corrupt incremental updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the repository convention for RECTANGLE_16 as inclusive left/top/right/bottom coordinates.
Audit framebuffer dirty collection, publisher snapshots, accumulator logic, and RDPEGFX surface command construction for consistent inclusive bounds.
Invalid or out-of-bounds rectangles are rejected or clamped before entering the RDPEGFX pending accumulator.
Tests cover edge rectangles at x=0/y=0, right=width-1, bottom=height-1, one-pixel rects, and invalid/out-of-bounds rects.

userStories.title: Add RDPEGFX command bounds validation tests/logging
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want RDPEGFX command construction to validate source rectangles and payload bounds so invalid dirty regions are caught before they reach FreeRDP send callbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: RDPEGFX dirty command builders verify width, height, stride, pixel buffer size, rect bounds, and payload length before send.
Invalid command input fails safely without sending partial RDPEGFX frames.
Debug logging identifies rejected command bounds with viewer id, generation, rect, surface size, and reason without INFO spam.
Unit tests cover invalid rects, zero-size rects, dimension mismatch, oversized payload prevention, and valid edge rects.

userStories.title: Strengthen ACK/backpressure pacing behavior
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want RDPEGFX dirty sending to respect ACK, in-flight, byte, and client-suspension backpressure without losing pending damage or blocking unrelated viewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Dirty pacing checks happen before moving pending dirty work to a local batch.
ACK timeout, acknowledgement suspension, max in-flight frames, and max in-flight bytes defer sends without dropping pending damage.
Backpressure state is per viewer and does not affect classic forwarding or other RDPEGFX viewers.
Deferred sends leave a wake path so pending dirty work retries when pacing allows.
Metrics/logs capture defer reason, in-flight frame count, in-flight bytes, latest pending generation, and pending rect count.
Unit tests cover ACK timeout suspend, ACK resume, byte backpressure, frame-count backpressure, and per-viewer isolation.

userStories.title: Add bounded conservative full-frame fallback controls
userStories.description: As an operator, I want conservative RDPEGFX fallback controls that can recover from suspicious incremental damage without making full-frame uncompressed updates the default.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing viewer.gfx.diagnostic.full_frame_dirty remains diagnostic-only and default false.
Add or document bounded production-safe full-frame fallback triggers for extreme pending region count, high pending area, resize/reset, or repeated dirty-send deferrals.
Fallback controls are viewer-side only and do not alter backend codec negotiation or enable backend GFX/RemoteFX/NSCodec.
Logs clearly distinguish diagnostic forced full-frame dirty from threshold-based full-frame fallback.
Config defaults preserve current behavior unless a bounded fallback threshold is explicitly reached.
Tests cover default false behavior and threshold-triggered full-frame fallback.

userStories.title: Harden RDPEGFX surface lifecycle on baseline/reset/resize/reconnect
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want RDPEGFX surface lifecycle transitions to clear stale dirty state so old generations cannot be sent after a baseline, reset, resize, fallback, disconnect, or reconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful RDPEGFX baseline send clears pending dirty accumulator and dirty frame mapping for that viewer.
Surface invalidation, resize, reconnect, viewer cleanup, dirty reset, and classic fallback clear pending accumulator state.
Dimension changes cannot re-use pending dirty rectangles from the previous surface size.
Stale ACKs from old surfaces or epochs cannot unsuspend or clear current dirty state incorrectly.
Tests cover baseline clear, resize clear, surface invalidation clear, cleanup/uninit clear, and stale ACK isolation.

userStories.title: Add RDPEGFX diagnostics and counters
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want runtime counters and targeted logs for RDPEGFX dirty accumulation and sends so corruption, lag, and fallback decisions can be diagnosed from logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Expose or log per-viewer pending dirty rect count, pending area, start/latest pending generation, moved batch generation, sent generation, defer reason, full-frame fallback count, and remerge count.
Startup logs include relevant viewer GFX settings, including codec, RDPEGFX enabled state, diagnostic full-frame dirty, and any conservative fallback thresholds.
Dirty rejection/defer logs are WLog_DBG or otherwise rate-limited to avoid INFO spam during normal operation.
Important mode/fallback transitions are visible at INFO or WARN with viewer id and generation context.
Unit tests cover counter increments where feasible without a real RDP client.

userStories.title: Add runtime/manual validation evidence for shadow-aligned RDPEGFX
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want repeatable runtime validation evidence proving uncompressed RDPEGFX stays visually aligned during common desktop interactions before considering the path production-ready.
acceptanceCriteria: Create or update a manual validation checklist covering initial baseline, Start menu open/close, window drag, window resize, overlapping windows, text editing, reconnect, and resize scenarios.
Checklist includes required config: viewer.gfx.enabled=true, viewer.gfx.codec=uncompressed, viewer.gfx.diagnostic.full_frame_dirty=false.
Validation confirms no ghosting, black fragments, stale window trails, or canvas fragmentation under normal interaction.
Validation captures relevant logs/counters showing accumulated pending dirty generations are sent or intentionally deferred.
Document any remaining known limitations or client-specific observations.

userStories.title: Validate RFX only after uncompressed RDPEGFX is clean
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want RFX/RemoteFX viewer codec work to remain secondary until uncompressed RDPEGFX proves visually correct, so codec artifacts are not confused with dirty-region bugs.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not enable RFX by default and do not change backend codec negotiation.
Only test viewer.gfx.codec=rfx after US-010 uncompressed validation passes cleanly.
RFX validation uses the same dirty accumulation, coordinate, lifecycle, and pacing logic as uncompressed RDPEGFX.
Any RFX-specific artifacts are documented separately from dirty-region correctness issues.
Existing uncompressed RDPEGFX tests remain the primary gate.
